editorial.name: Superpower
editorial.descriptionZh: Superpower 是年费制的健康体检会员，一年两次抽血覆盖 150 多项生物标记物，配一支随时的照护团队和会随数据更新的健康方案。$349 一年，可用 HSA/FSA 支付。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它如何把一张逆光人像当作全部首屏视觉
editorial.noteZh: 首屏整块是一张暖橙色逆光人像，左侧压着 HSA/FSA eligible 一行小字与 Your new health membership 两行白字，下面写 Members get 150+ lab tests across 2 blood draws. $349 per year.。按钮是白色实心 Become a member 与半透明 See what we test。导航极简，左边 What we test、Reviews、FAQs、For Employers，中间一枚小写 superpower 字标，右边 Log in 与黑色 Become a member。往下是 How it works 四步：Build your baseline、See what matters、Build your protocol、Retest and refine，再后面是 Every membership starts with 150+ biomarkers 一段，说可在 2,000+ Quest locations 或 at-home 抽血，另一处数字写 6M+ biomarkers analyzed。页面左下角压着一条 cookie 面板，写 By clicking Accept, you agree to the storing of cookies on your device。
editorial.pricing: paid：Members get 150+ lab tests across 2 blood draws. $349 per year.

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Superpower 会员的检测项目、流程与价格说明，没有可下载的资源；候选池从 saaslandingpage.com 落地页灵感目录收进来，故归产品与公司官网。
导航只有 What we test、Reviews、FAQs、For Employers 与 Log in、Become a member，站内还有 /biomarkers、/how-it-works、/checkout，是会员制的产品门面。
